title: Magneto-conversion anode design for unlocking high energy density and dendrite-free hybrid lithium–ion/lithium–metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9561-9574
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02644J, Paper
Song Kyu Kang, Minho Kim, Seochan Hong, Jae-Hong Lim, Gwan Hyeon Park, Junhyuk Ji, Jeongbin Cho, Hansol Bae, Won Bae Kim
A magnetically tailored conversion strategy integrates ferromagnetic oxides with an external magnetic field to regulate Li+ flux and homogenize nucleation barriers, thereby enabling dendrite-free Li deposition and enhancing energy density.
